characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: field emission Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) and Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD) system (EBSD-FEI Quanta-650 FEG)
characterization_methods.key_findings: After cold rolling, the bainite is elongated and aligned with the rolling direction, with minor fresh martensite present.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Etching: 4% nitric acid ethanol solution. Electropolishing electrolyte: 80% ethanol, 15% perchloric acid, 5% glycerol, conducted at 28 V and 0.1 A for 15–30 s.
characterization_methods.purpose: To characterize the phase composition and microstructure of the cold-rolled sample (Fig. 2(b)).

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Cold rolling was performed on a four-roll reversible mill with a 60% reduction rate, resulting in plates with a thickness of 1.6 mm (applied to the hot-rolled plate).

phases_present.morphology: elongated morphology aligned with the rolling direction
minor amounts interspersed within the bainite

structures.overall_structure: Cold-rolled microstructure: bainite exhibits an elongated morphology aligned with the rolling direction and is interspersed with minor amounts of fresh martensite.
